hyperedges.label: Time Series + LLM Reasoning
hyperedges.description: The arc from zero-shot TS forecasting with frozen LLMs, through the diagnosis that forecasting does not imply reasoning, to aligned TS-LLM models, RL-incentivized reasoning, verifiable thinking data, and clinical benchmarks.

hyperedges.label: Latent / Continuous Reasoning
hyperedges.description: Reasoning moved off language tokens: superposition theory for continuous chain-of-thought, then latent visual reasoning in Monet. Related Zotero items already in reasoning.md: Coconut, CODI, Chain of Superposition (Deng), Latent Space Survey.

hyperedges.label: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
hyperedges.description: Do CoT traces reflect actual reasoning? Unfaithful explanations, faithfulness measurement, per-step necessity and accuracy probes, and hallucination snowballing through generation.

hyperedges.label: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought
hyperedges.description: Chain-of-thought generalized to interleaved modalities: interleaved-modal CoT, grounded CoT, internalized visual thinking; plus the visual-token efficiency line (1/2 tokens after layer 2, one-token LLaVA-Mini).

hyperedges.label: Time Series Foundation Models
hyperedges.description: Decoder-only forecasting foundation models and wearable-sensing foundation models; TS-Reasoner aligns them with LLM reasoning.

hyperedges.label: Vision SSL and Regularization Classics
hyperedges.description: Regularization lineage (Dropout to Cutout) and the masked-autoencoder self-supervised vision anchor; MIRAGE evaluates whether VLMs truly understand images.

hyperedges.label: LLM Efficiency and Analysis Foundations
hyperedges.description: Transformer analysis beyond attention (residual and normalization layers) and the attention-sink fix for streaming inference.
